messages.author: 1161df5ae7a276da
messages.subject: linked_brush philosophy
parts:
Hi again ggvis team,

I am having great fun working with linked_brush() between scatterplots.

The fun then turned to experimentation, as I tried to make a link between a scatterplot and a histogram. 

The goal was to brush a scatterplot and to have the bars of the histogram (or proper proportion thereof) respond in kind. 

A further goal was to be able to brush the histogram and show the corresponding points on the scatterplot.

It didn't go well, as I'm pretty sure I'm not supposed to be able to do this (yet). 

My guess is that the transform_bin() us getting in the way, and it doesn't help that there is not a one-to-one correspondence between the marks of the histogram and the marks of the scatterplot.

Anyhow, could this be something we might imagine being able to do in the future (or even to have linked_brush() among histograms of different variables representing the same dataframe)?

Thanks as always for entertaining my crazy questions,

Ian
